title: Founder Mode, Product Quality, and Design Reviews
content:
Demo source notes — original paraphrase, not a verbatim transcript.

Founder mode can be framed as staying sufficiently close to product quality and customer experience while an organization scales. It is not simply doing every task personally.

Regular product and design reviews can expose problems that aggregate dashboards may not reveal. Useful reviews focus on the customer problem, alternatives considered, reasoning, and quality of the proposed solution.

As a company grows, leadership can make good judgment more scalable through principles, recurring review mechanisms, clear ownership, and strong communication. Delegation can increase without abandoning accountability for product quality.
